intro: CAVA Organic Chocolate Milk is a delicious, naturally sweetened beverage made with organic whole milk, cocoa, and cane sugar. At just 150 calories with 8g of protein, this drink offers a wholesome treat that complements any meal from the [full CAVA menu](/). Perfect for those seeking a nostalgic yet nutritious beverage option alongside their Mediterranean favorites.
priceCalories: Priced between $2.75 and $3.15, CAVA Organic Chocolate Milk delivers 150 calories per serving. With 8g of protein, 20g of carbs, and 5g of fat, it provides balanced nutrition at an affordable price point. This organic drink option stands out among other selections on the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks) for its quality ingredients and reasonable cost.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets this chocolate milk apart is its commitment to organic ingredients without artificial additives or preservatives. Made with organic whole milk, real cocoa, and pure cane sugar, it delivers authentic chocolate flavor. Unlike conventional chocolate milk, CAVA sources premium organic ingredients that align with their Mediterranean-inspired commitment to quality and wholesome eating.
nutritionFacts: Each serving contains 150 calories with a balanced macronutrient profile: 8g of protein for muscle support, 20g of carbohydrates for energy, and 5g of fat from organic whole milk. The protein content makes it more substantial than typical soft drinks. Check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to see how this beverage fits into your daily nutritional goals.
whatsInside: CAVA Organic Chocolate Milk contains just three simple ingredients: organic whole milk, cocoa, and cane sugar. The organic whole milk provides calcium and protein, while real cocoa delivers rich chocolate flavor and antioxidants. Cane sugar offers natural sweetness without high-fructose corn syrup or artificial sweeteners found in many conventional chocolate milk products.
tasteLike: This organic chocolate milk tastes rich, creamy, and authentically chocolatey without being overly sweet. The organic whole milk creates a smooth, velvety texture while the real cocoa provides deep chocolate flavor. It has a balanced sweetness from cane sugar that enhances rather than overwhelms the natural milk and cocoa taste, offering a satisfying and refreshing beverage experience.
customize: Organic Chocolate Milk comes ready to enjoy as a standalone beverage and does not require customization. However, you can enhance your meal experience by pairing it strategically with items from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) or [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas). Consider it as a protein-rich complement to balance spicier menu items or lighter salad-based meals.
pairsWell: This chocolate milk pairs excellently with spicy dishes, helping to cool the palate when enjoying harissa or spicy options from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains). It also complements sweet items from the [CAVA Desserts Menu](/menu/desserts) or serves as a satisfying beverage alongside savory pitas and bowls. The creamy texture balances Mediterranean herbs and bold flavors beautifully.
healthyChoice: With organic ingredients and 8g of protein per serving, this chocolate milk offers more nutritional value than standard sodas or sugary beverages. The organic whole milk provides calcium for bone health while avoiding artificial ingredients. At 150 calories, it remains a moderate indulgence. For those monitoring specific nutrients, review the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) for complete dietary information.
howToOrder: Simply add Organic Chocolate Milk to your order when selecting beverages at any CAVA location. Available at all participating restaurants, you can request it at the counter when ordering your bowl, pita, or salad. Find your nearest restaurant using [CAVA Locations](/locations) to enjoy this organic beverage with your favorite Mediterranean meal today.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Classic Lemonade at 260-360 calories, Organic Chocolate Milk offers fewer calories at 150 while providing 8g of protein that lemonade lacks. Blueberry Lavender options contain 140-190 calories but no protein content. The chocolate milk delivers superior nutritional value with organic certification, making it ideal for those seeking protein-rich, naturally sweetened beverage options.
whoShouldTry: This organic chocolate milk is perfect for health-conscious families, fitness enthusiasts needing post-workout protein, and anyone who appreciates organic ingredients. Children and adults alike enjoy the familiar chocolate flavor while parents appreciate the clean ingredient list. Those seeking alternatives to artificially sweetened drinks or conventional chocolate milk will find this option particularly appealing.
worthTrying: CAVA Organic Chocolate Milk is absolutely worth trying for its exceptional quality, organic ingredients, and balanced nutrition. At $2.75-$3.15, it offers excellent value for a protein-rich organic beverage. The combination of nostalgic chocolate milk flavor with premium organic ingredients makes it a standout choice that satisfies cravings while supporting your wellness goals.

faqs.q: How many calories are in CAVA Organic Chocolate Milk?
faqs.a: CAVA Organic Chocolate Milk contains 150 calories per serving, along with 8g of protein, 20g of carbohydrates, and 5g of fat from organic whole milk.

faqs.q: What ingredients are in CAVA Organic Chocolate Milk?
faqs.a: This beverage contains only three organic ingredients: organic whole milk, cocoa, and cane sugar. No artificial sweeteners, preservatives, or additives are included.

faqs.q: How much does CAVA Organic Chocolate Milk cost?
faqs.a: CAVA Organic Chocolate Milk is priced between $2.75 and $3.15, depending on location. This affordable price point makes it accessible for most customers.

faqs.q: Is CAVA Organic Chocolate Milk suitable for children?
faqs.a: Yes, CAVA Organic Chocolate Milk is excellent for children due to its organic ingredients, calcium content, and 8g of protein without artificial additives or preservatives.

faqs.q: Does CAVA Organic Chocolate Milk contain dairy?
faqs.a: Yes, this chocolate milk is made with organic whole milk and contains dairy. Those with lactose intolerance or dairy allergies should choose alternative beverage options.
